t: This is St Joseph, a Catholic church in Leyton, in the borough of Waltham Forest. It was designed by Ernest Bower Norris, an architect who worked mostly in the north-west of England. A review published in 1938 credited him with around eighty schools and over forty churches. In his church work he often favoured neo-byzantine or romanesque styles, and his buildings are usually brick, often with a steel or concrete frame behind. Look at the brickwork and see how it fits that description.
